key_insight: T-MoXAI is a three-level explainability framework that shows when, from which modality, and from which features or regions a temporal multimodal model makes its predictions.
clinical_relevance: It can help clinicians and researchers understand and trust AI outputs on complex time-based data such as ultrasound, lab measurements, and other multimodal healthcare inputs.
method: Temporal Shapley values identify which timepoints matter most.
Attention analysis shows which modality contributes at those moments.
Gradient-based attribution highlights the specific features or image regions driving the decision.
evidence_signal: The framework was tested on IVF outcome prediction (AUC 0.660) and wheat yield forecasting ($R^2$ 0.265), with temporal modeling shown to be essential in both tasks.
watch_item: The reported performance is modest, so the framework may improve interpretability more than predictive accuracy and would need careful validation before real-world use.
paper_title: T-MoXAI: A Hierarchical Explainability Framework for Temporal Multimodal Data
